question: Should OpenClaw expose a bounded public config or environment override for the exec approval pending window, and if so which key, precedence, and maximum should be the supported contract?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but adding a knob changes host-exec authorization timing and creates public config/API surface that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded config contract
options.body: Add one documented timeout key with conservative bounds and thread the resolved value through every approval registration, wait, and transport path.

options.title: Keep fixed default
options.body: Leave the 30-minute fail-closed default as the only supported behavior and close or retitle duplicate timeout-knob requests.

options.title: Prefer UX recovery only
options.body: Avoid a timeout knob for now and improve missed-approval recovery or notification surfaces instead.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded config contract
recommendation.body: Add one documented timeout key with conservative bounds and thread the resolved value through every approval registration, wait, and transport path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal points to the shared timeout constant and prior maintainer review on configurable-timeout attempts.
